_help: This file controls how your GitHub projects appear on the website AND in the resume.
Any public repo NOT listed here still appears automatically, using its GitHub name and description.
pinned: repos shown first, in this order. hide: repos to leave out everywhere.
notes: optional nicer title, description, live app link (liveUrl), tech list, and resume bullet points.
resumeExtras: projects that are not GitHub repos (or should appear in the resume in a special place).
Edit on GitHub with the pencil icon, then Commit. The site and resume update by themselves.

resume: Installable web app (PWA) that tracks hackathons, workshops, meetups and competitions across Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Bengaluru and online.
